name: NFI Hospital Approval
response_html:
Dear {{ hospital }} Team,

Greetings from Neonates Foundation of India.

We appreciate your team's efforts throughout the process. NFI will sponsor Rs. {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(director_approved_amount, 0) }} ({{ frappe.utils.money_in_words(director_approved_amount, 'INR') }}) for {{ baby_name }}.

To facilitate disbursement, please submit the following original documents at discharge:

  1. Final discharge summary.
  2. Final bills mentioning hospital discount and NFI Sponsor Fund.
  3. Additional treatment bills or receipts.
  4. Informed consent form for post-discharge video and pictures.
  5. Payment requisition letter.

Upon receipt of these documents, we will process the payout. Please contact us for any clarification.

Warm regards
NFI Coordinator
Neonates Foundation of India
subject: {{ case_number }} Sponsor approval notification – {{ baby_name }}

To facilitate disbursement, please submit the following original documents at discharge:

  1. Final discharge summary with the sticker of the vial used.
  2. Final bill with the surfactant bill attached.
  3. Final bills mentioning NFI Sponsor Fund.
  4. Payment requisition letter.

Upon receipt of these documents, we will process the payout. Please contact us for any clarification.

Warm regards
NFI Coordinator
Neonates Foundation of India
